resources.name: Density functional theory (DFT) code with LDA capability (e.g., CP2K)

access.notes: Any open-source DFT package supporting LDA and all-electron or pseudopotential calculations suitable for cluster (molecular) systems.

resources.name: Pseudopotentials or basis sets for Ga, As, Si, H (LDA)

access.package: CP2K or other DFT package included basis/pseudopotential libraries
access.notes: Standard LDA pseudopotentials/basis sets for Ga, As, Si, H are available within CP2K and similar codes.

resources.name: GaAs crystal structure (lattice constant and atomic positions)

access.notes: The zinc-blende GaAs structure with known experimental lattice constant (e.g., 5.65 Å) is sufficient to build the cluster.
